title: Three Evenings and One Short String
subtitle: 音乐之声 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 音乐之声（人与社会·文学、艺术与体育·音乐与表演）
meta: 主题语境：音乐之声（人与社会·文学、艺术与体育·音乐与表演）　|　核心词汇：guitar　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 guitar 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the teacher ① tuned a guitar that no pupil in the room would have described, and he said the tuning was the whole of the evening. The ② guitar, meaning the instrument itself and not the case, ran three evenings and stayed undescribed in the book; a guitar, he said, is the only thing in a room that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ guitar in that room had the same short string beside it, and the ④ guitar at the far wall, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A guitar, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the teacher said the describing is the part that fills three evenings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the guitar was the whole of the matter, meaning the music and not the instrument. The ⑥ guitar, meaning the music and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; guitar, he said, is either something you tune or the only word that means both an instrument and a music. He said the music is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ guitar had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short string. The ⑧ guitar of the whole thing, the teacher wrote in November, was one room and three evenings of describing; guitar, he said, is either the one at the far wall or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ guitar I remember is the one described in the list, which closed in 1981 and is still described as the quietest in the room. A ⑩ guitar, my mother said in 1983, is the only one that improves by being described; every guitar, she said, is a music that has agreed to look like an instrument. She said the music was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 吉他（指房间里每一把旁边的那一把）
B. n. 吉他（指那件乐器本身，与琴盒相对）
C. 固定搭配：tune a guitar 给吉他调音
D. n. 吉他（指留给孩子们学着弹的那一把）
E. n. 吉他声（抽象总称，指一间房间的吉他之事）
F. n. 吉他（指清单里写到、被登记过的那一把）
G. n. 吉他声；吉他演奏（指一件事里人人都听却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 琴声（抽象总称，指人人都听却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: tuned a guitar that no pupil in the room would have described
The guitar, meaning the instrument itself and not the case
the guitar at the far wall
the guitar was the whole of the matter
the guitar had become a line in a list
The guitar of the whole thing
A guitar, my mother said in 1983

answers.why: tune a guitar 意为“给吉他调音”，1974 年那位老师给一把房间里没有一位学生肯描述的吉他调了音。
guitar 意为“吉他”，指那件乐器本身而不是琴盒，它经过了三个傍晚而在簿子上没有被描述。
guitar 意为“吉他”，指房间里每一把旁边的那一把，每一把旁边都有同一根矮矮的琴弦。
guitar 意为“吉他”，指最远那面墙边留给孩子们学着弹的那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
guitar 意为“吉他声、吉他演奏”，指一件事里人人都听却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这阵琴声就是那件事的全部。
guitar 意为“琴声”，指人人都听却无人提起的那样东西而不是那把吉他，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
guitar 意为“吉他”，指清单里写到、被登记过的那一把，到 1979 年这一把成了清单里的一行。
guitar 意为“吉他声”，老师十一月写道，整件事的吉他之事是一间房间和三个傍晚的描述。
guitar 意为“吉他”，我记得的是清单里描述过的那一把，1981 年送出去了，至今仍被说成房间里最安静的一把。
guitar 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，吉他是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的乐器。
